title: yoshito-ishiki-math/lean-scottish-book-155
summary: A Lean proof that there are real Banach spaces X and Y and a bijection U from X to Y which preserves every pairwise distance on every closed ball of radius one quarter while failing to be a global isometry. This gives a counterexample to Scottish Book Problem 155.

formalizes.title: AI-Assisted Research Report: A counterexample to Scottish Book Problem 155

review.reason: Lean proof of a counterexample to Scottish Book Problem 155 on isometries.
